engineLock:
# LilyPond engine pin (ADR-0001 D4 / ADR-0002 §8). Source of truth for scripts/engine.mjs.
# The unpacked tree lives in vendor/lilypond/<tag> and is gitignored; it is reproducible
# from this lock, so `git clone` + `pnpm engine` reconstructs it byte-for-byte.
tag = "2.26.0-darwin-arm64"
version = "2.26.0"
url = "https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/lilypond%2Flilypond/packages/generic/lilypond/2.26.0/lilypond-2.26.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz"
file = "lilypond-2.26.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz"
sha256 = "18ffc454fef3753c26a015d95a3c232f89b22f052b897c046e0198740a1221be"
# LilyPond compiles its Guile modules at first run and refuses to start when a `.go`
# file is older than its `.scm` source (see ADR alternatives-evaluation §3.13). `tar`
# restores mtimes, so extraction is safe; any copy that flattens mtimes is not.
touch_newer = "*.go"
